title: game/speech.json
description: The speech models of the target language (T04, research G6): the recognizer, the synthesizer with the guide's voice, and the recognition thresholds keyed by the recognizer they were tuned on. Every model id is an id of models/manifest.json (the content validation checks it). The NPCs' voices stay in game/npcs/<id>.json. Loaded by SpeechTable (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

model.description: The id of the constrained-recognition model (role asr-constrained) in models/manifest.json.

engine.description: The synthesizer engine's id. The game runs 'kokoro' so far; any other id fails the content validation.

model.description: The id of the TTS model (role tts) in models/manifest.json.

speaker.description: The speaker id inside the TTS model (Kokoro: 28 is ef_dora).

voiceId.description: The voice's label, which goes into the synthesis cache's key.

thresholds.description: For each ASR model id, the numbers tuned on it. The table's ASR model must have an entry.

wordConfidence.description: The mean per-word confidence under which a recognition is uncertain (D-game-9).
